status: registered before portfolio dev or test execution
hypothesis: Keeping PDF page boundaries makes citations open the specific evidence page and reduces irrelevant context versus merging short pages into 600-token chunks.
variable: chunk_page_boundaries false versus true; within-page token size and overlap unchanged
corpus: fixtures/portfolio/manifest.json, original synthetic 10 runbooks, 100 templated questions, 50 physical pages
held_out: 70 questions from seven disjoint documents; run only after locking configuration
acceptance: Prefer page boundaries if exact-page browser test passes, dev evidence recall loses at most 5 percentage points, and no new scope or lifecycle regression. Report negative results and all errors.
quality_review: Mechanical evidence metrics; content review by AI assistant is recorded separately and is not independent human validation.
budget_method: Bounded token reservations including retry ceilings before paid operations; save each run and sum reported usage separately. Allocations are ceilings, not reported spending.
